description: This file defines the DeserializationException class used for error handling within the Laminas Diactoros exception namespace. It provides static methods for creating exception instances related to deserialization issues in HTTP message processing.

classes.name: DeserializationException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending UnexpectedValueException for deserialization errors in HTTP message processing.

methods.name: forInvalidHeader
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an invalid header was detected.

methods.name: forInvalidHeaderContinuation
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an invalid header continuation.

methods.name: forRequestFromArray
methods.description: Creates an exception when deserialization of a request from an array fails.

methods.name: forResponseFromArray
methods.description: Creates an exception when deserialization of a response from an array fails.

methods.name: forUnexpectedCarriageReturn
methods.description: Creates an exception for an unexpected carriage return.

methods.name: forUnexpectedEndOfHeaders
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an unexpected end of headers.

methods.name: forUnexpectedLineFeed
methods.description: Creates an exception for an unexpected line feed.
